name: merriam-webster-raycast
title: Merriam-Webster Learner
description: Search Merriam-Webster Learner's Dictionary from Raycast
author: zeeshan

commands.name: search-learner
commands.title: Search Learner Dictionary
commands.description: Search Merriam-Webster Learner entries as you type

commands.name: lookup-learner
commands.title: Lookup Learner Word
commands.description: Lookup an exact Merriam-Webster Learner entry

commands.name: lookup-selection
commands.title: Lookup Selected Word
commands.description: Lookup the currently selected text in Merriam-Webster Learner's Dictionary

preferences.name: learnerApiKey
preferences.title: Learner API Key
preferences.description: Your Merriam-Webster Learner's Dictionary API key

scripts.lint: ray lint && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const manifest=require('./package.json'); const files=(manifest.commands ?? []).map((command)=>'src/' + command.name + '.tsx'); const missing=files.filter((file)=>!fs.existsSync(file)); if (missing.length) { console.error('Missing command files: ' + missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1); }"
